Manage Topics Guides PS5 Release Dates Features These 28+ PS5 and PS Plus Games Are Coming Out Next Week (2nd-8th November) Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters! CRYMELIGHT! Zero Parades! by Sammy Barker 8 hours ago Share: We’re fast approaching the GTA 6 evacuation zone, so expect the number of new releases to dip dramatically in November. There are some noteworthy titles this time, though, with highlights including the PS5 version of Zero Parades as well as Alice in Wonderland roguelite CRYMELIGHT . Here's everything coming out next week. On this page: These 28+ PS5 and PS Plus Games Are Coming Out Next Week (2nd-8th November) 1. New PS5 Games Next Week (2nd-8th November) 2. New PS Plus Games Next Week New PS5 Games Next Week (2nd-8th November) Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is coming to PS5 on 3rd November Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered (3rd November - PS5): "The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer." Let's Sing 2027 (3rd November - PS5): "Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances." Pit of Goblin (3rd November - PS5): "Ever dreamt of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly that even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin, that’s every day! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns, and ghost-infested ruins. Every step is fraught with peril and surprise! Your purpose is feeding the King Queen’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery!" Solo Leveling Arise: Overdrive (3rd November - PS5): "The globally acclaimed webtoon Solo Leveling comes to life as an action RPG! Experience intense, action-packed combat, unleash Sung Jinwoo's power as the Shadow Monarch, and team up with friends in thrilling 4-player co-op raids!" The Slormancer (3rd November - PS5): "The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer! Play as a Mighty Knight, a Fierce Huntress or a Mischievous Mage, master hundreds of abilities and ancestral powers, gear up, fight for the reputation of your kind and prove your value to the realm." We Are Eva (3rd November - PS5): "Play in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling through them at will in this innovative 2D platformer that defies boundaries! I'm Eva, by the way, and I promise we'll have fun! Or maybe not... Maybe we'll both suffer horribly... How should I know? I'm just a video game character..." Zero Parades: Director's Cut (3rd November - PS5): "From ZA/UM comes ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies – a story-rich espionage RPG. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on a desperate assignment. Pick up the pieces of your broken network, untangle a bloody web of intrigue at the End of History, and prove yourself on the big stage or blow it all up – again." Cat-Astrophy (4th November - PS5): "Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced, challenging space action roguelite: its Star Cursor system and evolving modules force you to adapt your build and playstyle in every run, generating chaotic combat and precise jumps. The game delivers constant tension and rewards both improvisation and technical mastery." House Builder 2 (4th November - PS5): "In House Builder 2, you build your dream structures in a vibrant, open-world low-poly environment! Purchase materials for your work, load them up, and head off to diverse tasks in the ultimate building adventure!" Kingdom of Night (4th November - PS5): "Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror." Light: Black Cat and Amnesia Girl (4th November - PS5): "Led by a single black cat—whose glowing eyes are the only light illuminating the young girl’s path." Next of Kin: Epiphany (4th November - PS5): "Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation." Outbreak: Dead City (4th November - PS5): "Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style." VOID/BREAKER (4th November - PS5): "You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat. The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here." Worship (4th November - PS5): "Convert followers to your world-ending cult in this minion management action roguelike. Draw with blood to perform occult rituals, command a growing army of faithful and venture the world to corrupt it. The Old Ones have awakened and they await a vessel to prepare their arrival." CRYMELIGHT (5th November - PS5): "This is Wonderland, a prison for the souls of the dead. A girl bereft of her memories is granted the name "Alice" by her guide, the White Rabbit. She is led to the site of a tea party." Dark Alley (5th November - PS5): "London sends Detective Thomas Bennett to Japan expecting a straightforward missing-person investigation. Instead, he finds a city where everyone seems to know more than they're willing to admit." Dominus Gladiatus (5th November - PS5): "Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly tournament against rival Domini." Escape Academy 2: Back to School (5th November - PS5): "Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home." Faraway (5th November - PS5): "Faraway is an endless procedurally generated, mastery-driven arcade game about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive." Forefront (5th November - PSVR2): "From the creators of Breachers and Hyper Dash, Forefront delivers an all-out war experience like never before in VR. Engage in massive 32-player battles across a variety of expansive, semi-destructible environments, where strategy, skill, and teamwork decide the outcome." K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine (5th November - PS5): "Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game!" Where the Seeds Fall (5th November - PS5): "The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree. Hasbro: Junior Games Collection (6th November - PS5): "Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families." Shelterra the Skyworld (6th November - PS5): "Soar into an epic fantasy RPG adventure across Shelterra, a vast floating continent untouched by the mysterious corruption known as Odium. Claude dreams of becoming a professional adventurer, but a simple escort mission soon reveals a threat that could send his entire homeland crashing to the surface. When he discovers that his talking stone is actually an Artifact, a spirit destined to protect Shelterra, Claude joins forces with the Orlok regime and sets out on a journey through the Skyworld to uncover its secrets and save the floating continent from destruction."
